title: melee is strong: one crowbar swing kills a crawler, elites take two, pillagers three, and every hit reads
why: His order (2026-10-18, newest, binding): "melee should be really strong and a viable combat option, should one-shot a crawler". It replaces his note of 2026-10-13 (3 swings kill a crawler). The crowbar blow was a flat 18, so a crawler of 52 health took 3 swings and a higher enemy health setting made it worse. Now the blow is worked out from the body it lands on: a crawler or a snitch dies to one swing at any health setting, an elite one takes one more, a pillager 3 (an elite 4), every other machine takes a flat 30 (was 18, a sentry 5 swings), the Overseer keeps 18 and the golden enemy takes the flat 30. The swing arc is the 140 degrees it is drawn over (was 103), a hit shows its number and the hit marker, a pillager bleeds, a body left standing is held for the hit stop beat, and a kill kicks the screen harder with a low thud. Player 2 swing sends the host the same number (the copy has maxhp, elite, kind) and asks the host for the hit stop. The bare hands punch, the reach, the 420 ms clock, the blow from behind and the bot are unchanged.
now: melee is strong: one crowbar swing kills a crawler, an elite takes two, a pillager three, and each hit shows its number.
